summary: Windows screen/window shares now derive the selected source dimensions from the native-size JPEG preview and pass them into LiveKit's aspect-preserving RTP resolution cap. The setup waits for the preview dimensions instead of allowing an uncapped start.

checks.name: Pinned libwebrtc preview dimensions
checks.observation: The pinned libwebrtc.m150.7871.02 source-list implementation captures each new source for a JPEG thumbnail. SaveCaptureResult encodes the frame using its original width and height, so JPEG SOF dimensions recover the selected source size for screens and windows.

checks.name: JPEG dimensions and aspect-preserving profile scale
checks.observation: All 8 tests pass, including native JPEG dimension extraction and selected-profile scaling without cropping or upscaling. Windows blocks Start until the selected preview reports valid dimensions.

checks.name: Preview event / getSources ordering
checks.observation: The regression test passes when a thumbnail event arrives after getSources clears its cache but before the source-list method response is merged.

checks.name: Flutter analyzer and diff check
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter analyze && git diff --check
checks.observation: No analyzer issues; diff check passed.

checks.name: Windows runtime sender verification
checks.observation: A Windows host is still needed to verify the nine resolution/FPS profiles against outbound sender dimensions and bandwidth for both full-screen and window sources.

remaining: Run 720p, 1080p and 1440p profiles at 15, 30 and 60 FPS for Windows screen and window sources; compare outbound sender dimensions/FPS/bitrate with web and Flutter viewers and confirm no source edges are cropped.
